note: Each input has a non-integral quotient, which @divExact makes illegal. ReleaseSafe does not check float @divExact and returns the truncated quotient, which the model reproduces without throwing; ReleaseFast and ReleaseSmall return the plain quotient. The ReleaseFast no-illegal-behaviour-transfer premise (a model that does not throw implies legal execution) therefore does not hold for float @divExact.
